gpu_and_inference_boundary.render_adapter_selection: wgpu high-performance adapter within the selected OS backend
gpu_and_inference_boundary.compatibility_rule: Build the consumer bridge against the selected CUDA/TensorRT profile; the simulator package is unchanged.

validated_profiles.scope: Windows simulator with WSL consumer bridge

driver_requirements: Up-to-date DirectX 12 or Vulkan-capable graphics driver
Do not bundle GPU drivers with the release

targets.release_acceptance_scope: native x86_64 build/SDK tests plus software Vulkan startup and IPC diagnostics; discrete-GPU performance is not a release gate
driver_requirements: A system Vulkan loader with either a hardware driver or a software implementation such as llvmpipe
A hardware Vulkan GPU is recommended for real-time RGB capture but is not required by the internal-lab Linux acceptance gate
Do not bundle GPU drivers with the release
